method: Compared each manifest path and Git blob ID with the recursively enumerated current Math commit tree; required blob type. Re-read Math main immediately before recording.
limitations: This is an ad hoc Git-tree identity observation, not a tested general auditor or a final gate.
It does not rerun Lean, validate source-to-object or dependency-cache correspondence, independently recompute SHA-256, prove mathematical hypotheses, or establish all federation paths.
The result is tied to this observed current Math commit and is not a final pin snapshot.

mode_verification.scope: Current Math tree; the initial identity comparison checked blob type and SHA, then this separate read checked regular-file modes.
